@@ -0,0 +1,186 @@
+name: 'Install Racket runtime'
+description: >-
+  Job-local Racket installation from the official installer with an
+  exact-key installer-archive cache. The cache stores ONLY the published
+  installer archive (never a full Racket installation tree), keyed by OS,
+  architecture, variant, distribution, version, source URL and published
+  SHA-256. A checksum mismatch fails the job before anything is installed.
+inputs:
+  racket-version:
+    description: 'Racket version to install'
+    required: false
+    default: '8.10'
+  architecture:
+    description: 'Racket architecture'
+    required: false
+    default: 'x64'
+  variant:
+    description: 'Racket variant (CS or BC)'
+    required: false
+    default: 'CS'
+  distribution:
+    description: 'Racket distribution (full or minimal)'
+    required: false
+    default: 'full'
+  installer-sha256:
+    description: >-
+      Published SHA-256 of the official installer archive for this exact
+      tuple. Required: the archive is never executed or cached unverified.
+    required: true
+outputs:
+  racket-bin:
+    description: 'Directory containing racket/raco executables'
+    value: ${{ steps.install.outputs.racket-bin }}
+runs:
+  using: 'composite'
+  steps:
+    - name: Derive official installer URL and cache key
+      id: installer
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        RACKET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+        ARCHITECTURE: ${{ inputs.architecture }}
+        VARIANT: ${{ inputs.variant }}
+        DISTRIBUTION: ${{ inputs.distribution }}
+        INSTALLER_SHA256: ${{ inputs.installer-sha256 }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        # Mirror layout (download.racket-lang.org -> mirror.racket-lang.org):
+        #   full Linux   racket-<ver>-<plat>-<variant>.sh
+        #   full macOS   racket-<ver>-<plat>-<variant>.dmg
+        #   minimal      racket-minimal-<ver>-<plat>-<variant>.sh (Linux)
+        #               racket-minimal-<ver>-<plat>-<variant>.tgz (macOS)
+        # Variant is lowercase in published filenames (cs/bc).
+        variant_lc=$(printf '%s' "$VARIANT" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
+        case "${RUNNER_OS}:${ARCHITECTURE}" in
+          Linux:x64)   plat=x86_64-linux ;;
+          Linux:arm64) plat=aarch64-linux ;;
+          macOS:x64)   plat=x86_64-macosx ;;
+          macOS:arm64) plat=aarch64-macosx ;;
+          *) echo "::error::unsupported tuple ${RUNNER_OS}/${ARCHITECTURE}"; exit 1 ;;
+        esac
+
+        if [ "$DISTRIBUTION" = "minimal" ]; then
+          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "Linux" ]; then
+            file="racket-minimal-${RACKET_VERSION}-${plat}-${variant_lc}.sh"
+          else
+            file="racket-minimal-${RACKET_VERSION}-${plat}-${variant_lc}.tgz"
+          fi
+        elif [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "Linux" ]; then
+          file="racket-${RACKET_VERSION}-${plat}-${variant_lc}.sh"
+        else
+          file="racket-${RACKET_VERSION}-${plat}-${variant_lc}.dmg"
+        fi
+        url="https://download.racket-lang.org/installers/${RACKET_VERSION}/${file}"
+
+        # The cache key binds every dimension of the installer identity:
+        # OS, architecture, variant, distribution, version, the exact source
+        # URL and the published SHA-256. Exact key only — no prefix restore
+        # keys, so a different tuple can never satisfy this cache.
+        url_digest=$(printf '%s' "$url" | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16)
+        echo "url=$url"                    >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+        echo "archive=$(basename "$url")"  >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+        echo "cache-key=racket-installer-v1-${RUNNER_OS}-${ARCHITECTURE}-${VARIANT}-${DISTRIBUTION}-${RACKET_VERSION}-${url_digest}-${INSTALLER_SHA256}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+    # Exact key only. On a hit the cached archive is still verified against
+    # the published SHA-256 before use; on a miss the download is verified
+    # before installation. Either way an unverified archive never executes.
+    - name: Restore verified installer archive
+      id: installer-cache
+      uses: actions/cache@caa296126883cff596d87d8935842f9db880ef25
+      with:
+        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ steps.installer.outputs.archive }}
+        key: ${{ steps.installer.outputs.cache-key }}
+
+    - name: Download and verify installer archive
+      if: steps.installer-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        INSTALLER_URL: ${{ steps.installer.outputs.url }}
+        INSTALLER_ARCHIVE: ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ steps.installer.outputs.archive }}
+        INSTALLER_SHA256: ${{ inputs.installer-sha256 }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$INSTALLER_ARCHIVE" "$INSTALLER_URL"
+        actual=$(shasum -a 256 "$INSTALLER_ARCHIVE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+        if [ "$actual" != "$INSTALLER_SHA256" ]; then
+          echo "::error::installer archive checksum mismatch for $INSTALLER_URL"
+          echo "::error::expected $INSTALLER_SHA256"
+          echo "::error::actual   $actual"
+          exit 1
+        fi
+
+    - name: Re-verify cached installer archive
+      if: steps.installer-cache.outputs.cache-hit == 'true'
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        INSTALLER_ARCHIVE: ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ steps.installer.outputs.archive }}
+        INSTALLER_SHA256: ${{ inputs.installer-sha256 }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        actual=$(shasum -a 256 "$INSTALLER_ARCHIVE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+        if [ "$actual" != "$INSTALLER_SHA256" ]; then
+          echo "::error::cached installer archive no longer matches its published SHA-256; refusing to install"
+          exit 1
+        fi
+
+    - name: Install Racket into a job-local prefix
+      id: install
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        RACKET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+        INSTALLER_ARCHIVE: ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ steps.installer.outputs.archive }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        prefix="$RUNNER_TEMP/racket-${RACKET_VERSION}"
+        rm -rf "$prefix"
+        mkdir -p "$prefix"
+        case "$INSTALLER_ARCHIVE" in
+          *.tar.xz)
+            tar -xJf "$INSTALLER_ARCHIVE" -C "$prefix" --strip-components 1
+            ;;
+          *.tgz)
+            tar -xzf "$INSTALLER_ARCHIVE" -C "$prefix" --strip-components 1
+            ;;
+          *.dmg)
+            # macOS dmg layout: "Racket v<V>/Racket v<V>/{bin,lib,...}"
+            # (outer folder also carries an Applications symlink and
+            # install backgrounds). Locate the racket binary by search so
+            # nesting variations still resolve, and surface the mount
+            # listing on failure.
+            mount="$RUNNER_TEMP/racket-dmg"
+            rm -rf "$mount"
+            mkdir -p "$mount"
+            hdiutil attach -readonly -nobrowse -mountpoint "$mount" \
+              "$INSTALLER_ARCHIVE"
+            racket_src=$(find "$mount" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name racket | head -1)
+            if [ -z "$racket_src" ]; then
+              echo "::error::no racket binary found in the dmg image; mount contents:"
+              ls -la "$mount"
+              hdiutil detach "$mount" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+              exit 1
+            fi
+            # racket_src is .../<tree>/bin/racket — copy the whole tree root.
+            cp -R "$(dirname "$(dirname "$racket_src")")"/. "$prefix"/
+            hdiutil detach "$mount" >/dev/null
+            [ -x "$prefix/bin/racket" ] || {
+              echo "::error::racket not installed from dmg into $prefix"
+              exit 1
+            }
+            ;;
+          *.sh)
+            sh "$INSTALLER_ARCHIVE" --unix-style --dest "$prefix" --create-dir >/dev/null
+            ;;
+          *) echo "::error::unknown installer archive kind: $INSTALLER_ARCHIVE"; exit 1 ;;
+        esac
+        echo "$prefix/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+        echo "racket-bin=$prefix/bin" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+    - name: Confirm the installed runtime matches the requested tuple
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        RACKET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        racket --version
+        racket -e "(unless (string-prefix? (version) \"$RACKET_VERSION\") (exit 1))"

@@ -0,0 +1,177 @@
+name: 'Prepare Racket environment artifact'
+description: >-
+  Producer half of the prepared-environment contract (W3). Installs the
+  runtime job-locally via install-racket-runtime, installs the reviewed
+  dependency graph behind the exact lock, compiles q plus fmt, and packs an
+  immutable 24-hour artifact whose contents are restricted to the addon
+  store, the current-commit q compiled output and a manifest.json binding
+  the tuple (repository, git SHA, OS, arch, Racket tuple, lock digest,
+  source digest, allowlisted path set).
+inputs:
+  racket-version:
+    description: 'Racket version to prepare'
+    required: false
+    default: '8.10'
+  installer-sha256:
+    description: 'Published SHA-256 of the official installer archive'
+    required: true
+  variant:
+    description: 'Racket variant (CS or BC)'
+    required: false
+    default: 'CS'
+  distribution:
+    description: 'Racket distribution (full or minimal)'
+    required: false
+    default: 'full'
+  architecture:
+    description: 'Racket architecture'
+    required: false
+    default: 'x64'
+  artifact-name:
+    description: 'Name of the prepared-environment artifact'
+    required: true
+outputs:
+  lock-digest:
+    description: 'SHA-256 of the lock file used for the package store'
+    value: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.lock-digest }}
+  source-digest:
+    description: 'SHA-256 over the tracked source tree at this commit'
+    value: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.source-digest }}
+  artifact-name:
+    description: 'Name of the uploaded prepared-environment artifact'
+    value: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
+runs:
+  using: 'composite'
+  steps:
+    - name: Install the job-local Racket runtime
+      uses: ./.github/actions/install-racket-runtime
+      with:
+        racket-version: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+        architecture: ${{ inputs.architecture }}
+        variant: ${{ inputs.variant }}
+        distribution: ${{ inputs.distribution }}
+        installer-sha256: ${{ inputs.installer-sha256 }}
+
+    - name: Configure explicit user package store and derive tuple digests
+      id: tuple
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        RACKET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        addon_base="$HOME/.cache/q-racket-addon"
+        echo "PLTADDONDIR=$addon_base" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+        echo "addon_path=$addon_base/$RACKET_VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+        # Lock digest: SHA-256 over the lock file. Under the W1 version
+        # indexed schema this is the same material the verifier selects a
+        # version entry from; under the flat schema it still fully binds the
+        # reviewed package graph. Used as a cache-key and manifest dimension.
+        lock_digest=$(racket ci/prepared-environment/manifest.rkt digest --file ci/racket-package-lock.rktd)
+        echo "lock-digest=$lock_digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+        # Source digest: SHA-256 over the sorted (mode, blob, path) listing
+        # of every tracked file — deterministic for a given commit.
+        source_digest=$(git ls-files -s | LC_ALL=C sort | shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1)
+        echo "source-digest=$source_digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+    # Exact key only: every cache dimension derives from the requested
+    # runtime tuple and the lock digest, so one runtime's package store can
+    # never satisfy another runtime's job.
+    - name: Restore locked Racket user package store
+      id: addon-cache
+      uses: actions/cache@caa296126883cff596d87d8935842f9db880ef25
+      with:
+        path: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.addon_path }}
+        key: >-
+          racket-addon-v3-${{ runner.os }}-${{ inputs.architecture }}-${{ inputs.variant }}-
+          ${{ inputs.racket-version }}-${{ steps.tuple.outputs.lock-digest }}
+
+    - name: Install reviewed dependencies and compile q plus fmt
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        ADDON_PATH: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.addon_path }}
+        CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.addon-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        if [ "$CACHE_HIT" = "true" ]; then
+          raco pkg show --scope user q >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
+            echo "::error::exact package-store cache hit lacks the q user package"
+            exit 1
+          }
+          racket ci/verify-racket-package-lock.rkt
+          raco pkg update --name q --link --batch --no-setup "$PWD"
+        else
+          raco pkg install --name q --auto --batch --no-setup --no-docs "$PWD"
+          racket ci/verify-racket-package-lock.rkt
+        fi
+        raco setup --no-docs --jobs 4 --pkgs q fmt
+        raco fmt --help >/dev/null
+        racket -e '(require quickcheck fmt) (displayln "producer package store health check passed")'
+
+    - name: Pack the allowlisted prepared-environment artifact
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        RACKET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+        VARIANT: ${{ inputs.variant }}
+        DISTRIBUTION: ${{ inputs.distribution }}
+        ARCHITECTURE: ${{ inputs.architecture }}
+        ADDON_PATH: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.addon_path }}
+        LOCK_DIGEST: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.lock-digest }}
+        SOURCE_DIGEST: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.source-digest }}
+        ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        stage="$RUNNER_TEMP/prepared-env-${ARTIFACT_NAME}"
+        rm -rf "$stage"
+        mkdir -p "$stage/addon-store" "$stage/q-compiled"
+
+        # Allowlisted contents only (I10): the addon store and the q
+        # checkout's compiled output. No .git, no credentials, no tokens,
+        # no home-directory data ever enters the artifact.
+        cp -a "$ADDON_PATH/." "$stage/addon-store/"
+        while IFS= read -r -d '' dir; do
+          rel="${dir#./}"
+          mkdir -p "$stage/q-compiled/$rel"
+          cp -a "$dir/." "$stage/q-compiled/$rel/"
+        done < <(find . -type d -name compiled -not -path './.git/*' -print0)
+
+        git_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
+        racket ci/prepared-environment/manifest.rkt emit \
+          --out "$stage/manifest.json" \
+          --repository "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
+          --git-sha "$git_sha" \
+          --os "${RUNNER_OS}" \
+          --arch "$ARCHITECTURE" \
+          --racket-version "$RACKET_VERSION" \
+          --racket-variant "$VARIANT" \
+          --racket-distribution "$DISTRIBUTION" \
+          --lock-digest "$LOCK_DIGEST" \
+          --source-digest "$SOURCE_DIGEST" \
+          --allowlist 'addon-store/' \
+          --allowlist 'q-compiled/' \
+          --allowlist 'manifest.json'
+
+        # Self-check: the staged tree must already satisfy the contract this
+        # producer publishes, so a broken pack fails here and not downstream.
+        racket ci/prepared-environment/manifest.rkt verify \
+          --manifest "$stage/manifest.json" \
+          --expect-repository "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
+          --expect-git-sha "$git_sha" \
+          --expect-os "${RUNNER_OS}" \
+          --expect-arch "$ARCHITECTURE" \
+          --expect-racket-version "$RACKET_VERSION" \
+          --expect-lock-digest "$LOCK_DIGEST" \
+          --root "$stage"
+
+        du -sh "$stage" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+
+    # Immutable by construction: upload-artifact never overwrites an
+    # existing name and retention is pinned to one day (24h, I9).
+    - name: Upload the prepared-environment artifact
+      uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
+      with:
+        name: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
+        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/prepared-env-${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
+        retention-days: 1
+        if-no-files-found: error

@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+name: 'Restore prepared Racket environment'
+description: >-
+  Consumer half of the prepared-environment contract (W3). Downloads the
+  artifact produced by a `needs` producer, verifies manifest.json against
+  this job's tuple (repository, git SHA, OS, architecture, Racket version,
+  lock digest) and enforces the allowlist BEFORE any test runs, then
+  materializes the addon store and q compiled output and runs read-only
+  health checks. This action performs no package mutation and no collection
+  rebuild: a mismatch is always a failure, never a silent repair.
+inputs:
+  racket-version:
+    description: 'Racket version the artifact must have been built with'
+    required: false
+    default: '8.10'
+  installer-sha256:
+    description: 'Published SHA-256 of the official installer archive'
+    required: true
+  variant:
+    description: 'Racket variant (CS or BC)'
+    required: false
+    default: 'CS'
+  distribution:
+    description: 'Racket distribution (full or minimal)'
+    required: false
+    default: 'full'
+  architecture:
+    description: 'Racket architecture'
+    required: false
+    default: 'x64'
+  artifact-name:
+    description: 'Name of the prepared-environment artifact to restore'
+    required: true
+outputs:
+  lock-digest:
+    description: 'Lock digest of the restored environment'
+    value: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.lock-digest }}
+  restore-ms:
+    description: 'Wall-clock milliseconds spent downloading and restoring'
+    value: ${{ steps.restore.outputs.restore-ms }}
+runs:
+  using: 'composite'
+  steps:
+    # The consumer still installs the runtime job-locally (I8): only
+    # validated artifacts cross the job boundary, never a live filesystem.
+    - name: Install the job-local Racket runtime
+      uses: ./.github/actions/install-racket-runtime
+      with:
+        racket-version: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+        architecture: ${{ inputs.architecture }}
+        variant: ${{ inputs.variant }}
+        distribution: ${{ inputs.distribution }}
+        installer-sha256: ${{ inputs.installer-sha256 }}
+
+    - name: Download the prepared-environment artifact
+      uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
+      with:
+        name: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
+        # Never extract into the checkout: the artifact contains package
+        # sources (addon-store/) that a later raco setup would compile as
+        # part of the q package.
+        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/prepared-env-download
+
+    - name: Verify the manifest against this job tuple before anything else
+      id: tuple
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        RACKET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+        ARCHITECTURE: ${{ inputs.architecture }}
+        ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        # upload-artifact stores a single directory's bare contents, so the
+        # extractor layout varies; locate the manifest rather than guessing.
+        dl="$RUNNER_TEMP/prepared-env-download"
+        manifest=$(find "$dl" -type f -name manifest.json | head -1)
+        if [ -z "$manifest" ]; then
+          echo "::error::manifest.json missing from downloaded artifact"
+          exit 1
+        fi
+        root=$(dirname "$manifest")
+
+        git_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
+        echo "root=$root" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+        # Lock digest of THIS checkout, derived the same way the producer
+        # derived it, so a lock change between producer and consumer is a
+        # hard mismatch rather than a stale restore.
+        lock_digest=$(racket ci/prepared-environment/manifest.rkt digest --file ci/racket-package-lock.rktd)
+        echo "lock-digest=$lock_digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+        racket ci/prepared-environment/manifest.rkt verify \
+          --manifest "$root/manifest.json" \
+          --expect-repository "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
+          --expect-git-sha "$git_sha" \
+          --expect-os "${RUNNER_OS}" \
+          --expect-arch "$ARCHITECTURE" \
+          --expect-racket-version "$RACKET_VERSION" \
+          --expect-lock-digest "$lock_digest" \
+          --root "$root"
+
+        echo "::notice::prepared-environment manifest verified for ${RUNNER_OS}/${ARCHITECTURE} Racket ${RACKET_VERSION}"
+
+    - name: Materialize the addon store and q compiled output
+      id: restore
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        ROOT: ${{ steps.tuple.outputs.root }}
+        RACKET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.racket-version }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        start=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(int(time.time()*1000))')
+
+        addon_base="$HOME/.cache/q-racket-addon"
+        rm -rf "$addon_base/$RACKET_VERSION"
+        mkdir -p "$addon_base/$RACKET_VERSION"
+        cp -a "$ROOT/addon-store/." "$addon_base/$RACKET_VERSION/"
+        echo "PLTADDONDIR=$addon_base" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+        # q compiled output is placed back at its original checkout-relative
+        # paths. This is a copy, never a rebuild: if a compiled tree is
+        # missing from the artifact the health checks below fail.
+        while IFS= read -r -d '' dir; do
+          rel="${dir#$ROOT/q-compiled/}"
+          mkdir -p "$rel"
+          cp -a "$dir/." "$rel/"
+        done < <(find "$ROOT/q-compiled" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 5 -type d -name compiled -print0)
+
+        end=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(int(time.time()*1000))')
+        echo "restore-ms=$((end - start))" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+    - name: Health check 1/4 - runtime version
+      shell: bash
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        racket --version
+        racket -e "(displayln (version))"
+
+    - name: Health check 2/4 - dependency lock
+      shell: bash
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        racket ci/verify-racket-package-lock.rkt
+
+    - name: Health check 3/4 - require quickcheck and fmt
+      shell: bash
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        racket -e '(require quickcheck fmt) (displayln "restored store satisfies quickcheck + fmt")'
+
+    - name: Health check 4/4 - formatter command
+      shell: bash
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        raco fmt --help >/dev/null
+        echo "raco fmt command available from the restored store"

+          fi
           if [ "$INSTALL_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
             echo "::error::q dependency installation failed (INSTALL_RC=$INSTALL_RC). Reproduce locally with: racket scripts/ci-package-setup.rkt --preflight"
             exit "$INSTALL_RC"

@@ -1,5 +1,14 @@
 name: CI
 
+# W3 prepared-environment note (docs/reports/prepared-environment-pilot-v1.00.11.md):
+# The 26 setup-racket call sites below are the ONLY default path for this
+# workflow and remain unchanged until the recorded go decision. The
+# prepared-environment pilot is report-only (.github/workflows/
+# prepared-environment-pilot.yml) and never gates anything here. Rollback
+# switch for any future cutover: repository variable RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT=off

+
 env:
   FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
 
@@ -72,16 +81,25 @@ jobs:
       - name: Verify lint alignment
         run: racket scripts/check-lint-alignment.rkt
 
-      # Metadata lint (blocking): missing mandatory tags (@speed/@boundary
-      # on every test file) now fail the build. Invalid tags were always
-      # hard-failing inside the lint itself; this step must not weaken any
-      # existing check. Enforcement actually flipped at v1.00.06 — the
-      # documented v1.00.05 milestone slipped by one release because the

-      # (evidence: exit 0, missing-required=0 across 1,299 files) — see
-      # docs/TEST_CONVENTIONS.md "Test metadata schema: required vs conditional".
+      # Metadata lint (blocking): the repo-owned classifier
+      # scripts/run-tests/classify-metadata.rkt is the SINGLE discovery

+# W3 prepared-environment pilot — REPORT ONLY.
+#
+# This workflow gates nothing: it exists to produce the evidence recorded in
+# docs/reports/prepared-environment-pilot-v1.00.11.md (producer duration,
+# artifact size, consumer restore duration, cache-hit rate) and to prove the
+# negative cases of the prepared-environment contract:
+#
+#   * a tampered manifest must FAIL verification,
+#   * an artifact containing a non-allowlisted path must FAIL verification,
+#   * a valid restore must pass all four health checks,
+#   * RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT=off must reproduce the current per-job path.
+#
+# It never changes test selection or L4 semantics, and the 26 existing
+# setup-racket call sites in ci.yml keep running independently of it.
+name: prepared-environment-pilot
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - '.github/workflows/prepared-environment-pilot.yml'
+      - '.github/actions/install-racket-runtime/**'
+      - '.github/actions/prepare-racket-environment/**'
+      - '.github/actions/restore-racket-environment/**'
+      - 'ci/prepared-environment/**'
+      - 'ci/racket-package-lock.rktd'
+      - 'ci/verify-racket-package-lock.rkt'
+      - 'docs/reports/prepared-environment-pilot-v1.00.11.md'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: prepared-environment-pilot-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+# Tuple matrix: one producer per (OS, Racket version) tuple, plus consumers.
+# Racket 8.11 and macOS stay separate tuple pilots — no consumer cutover for
+# either in W3, and 8.11 waits for the W1 version-indexed lock entry.
+env:
+  # Published SHA-256 of each official installer archive (mirror.racket-lang.org,
+  # the redirect target of download.racket-lang.org). Keys and integrity
+  # checks bind these exact values; bump together with the version pins.
+  INSTALLER_SHA_LINUX_8_10: '497f0f518fa4c5f8529269580a6a79366f21315af26cf3ed1ae8b47e05ceac72'
+  INSTALLER_SHA_LINUX_8_11: '12243f96ae2b19cda684d2c4ed7a8c773bd201d2e598fe23a18ef704e5c0d212'
+  INSTALLER_SHA_MACOS_8_10: '2df9e29a3d690a7f83d7f5735446d0913f17265bfe6e7bea3214f22f346cbce9'
+
+jobs:
+  pilot:
+    name: pilot-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}-latest
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        include:
+          - os: ubuntu
+            racket-version: '8.10'
+            installer-sha: '497f0f518fa4c5f8529269580a6a79366f21315af26cf3ed1ae8b47e05ceac72'
+            role: full
+          - os: ubuntu
+            racket-version: '8.11'
+            # 8.11 is producer-pilot only until the W1 version-indexed lock
+            # entry is green; consumers are not enabled for this tuple.
+            installer-sha: '12243f96ae2b19cda684d2c4ed7a8c773bd201d2e598fe23a18ef704e5c0d212'
+            role: producer-only
+          - os: macos
+            racket-version: '8.10'
+            installer-sha: '2df9e29a3d690a7f83d7f5735446d0913f17265bfe6e7bea3214f22f346cbce9'
+            role: full
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8
+
+      - name: Probe whether the lock supports this tuple (W1 gate)
+        id: lock-gate
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          RACKET_VERSION: ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if grep -q "8\.11" ci/racket-package-lock.rktd || [ "$RACKET_VERSION" = "8.10" ]; then
+            echo "supported=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          else
+            echo "supported=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+            cat >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" <<EOF
+          ## 8.11 tuple pilot — blocked on W1
+          The version-indexed lock entry for 8.11 is not present in this
+          tree, so the 8.11 producer is reported as blocked rather than run
+          against a lock that cannot verify it. Per W3, 8.11 consumers stay
+          disabled until the W1 lock is green.
+          EOF
+          fi
+
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      # Producer: prepare the tuple-scoped immutable artifact.
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      - name: Produce prepared-environment artifact
+        id: producer
+        if: steps.lock-gate.outputs.supported == 'true'
+        uses: ./.github/actions/prepare-racket-environment
+        with:
+          racket-version: ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+          installer-sha256: ${{ matrix.installer-sha }}
+          artifact-name: prepared-env-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+
+      - name: Record producer metrics
+        if: steps.lock-gate.outputs.supported == 'true'
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          ROLE: ${{ matrix.role }}
+          RACKET_VERSION: ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+        run: |
+          cat >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" <<EOF
+          ### Producer ${{ matrix.os }}-latest / Racket ${RACKET_VERSION}
+          - role: ${ROLE}
+          - lock digest: \`${{ steps.producer.outputs.lock-digest }}\`
+          - source digest: \`${{ steps.producer.outputs.source-digest }}\`
+          EOF
+
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      # Consumers (only for tuples whose consumers may be validated).
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      - name: Restore and run all four health checks
+        id: restore
+        if: steps.lock-gate.outputs.supported == 'true' && matrix.role == 'full'
+        uses: ./.github/actions/restore-racket-environment
+        with:
+          racket-version: ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+          installer-sha256: ${{ matrix.installer-sha }}
+          artifact-name: prepared-env-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+
+      - name: Record consumer metrics
+        if: matrix.role == 'full'
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          cat >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" <<EOF
+          ### Consumer ${{ matrix.os }}-latest / Racket ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+          - restore wall-clock: ${{ steps.restore.outputs.restore-ms || 'n/a' }} ms
+          EOF
+
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      # Negative test A — tampered manifest must FAIL.
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      - name: Negative - tampered manifest must fail verification
+        if: matrix.role == 'full'
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          ARTIFACT_NAME: prepared-env-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+          RACKET_VERSION: ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/prepared-env-${ARTIFACT_NAME}"
+          cp "$root/manifest.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest.tampered.json"
+          # Corrupt the recorded git SHA: any mismatch must fail BEFORE tests.
+          racket -e '(require json) (define m (call-with-input-file (vector-ref (current-command-line-arguments) 0) read-json)) (define m2 (hash-set m (string->symbol "git_sha") "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000")) (call-with-output-file (vector-ref (current-command-line-arguments) 0) (lambda (o) (write-json m2 o)) #:exists (string->symbol "replace"))' "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest.tampered.json"
+
+          if racket ci/prepared-environment/manifest.rkt verify \
+              --manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest.tampered.json" \
+              --expect-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+              --expect-git-sha "$EXPECTED_SHA" \
+              --expect-os "$RUNNER_OS" \
+              --expect-arch x64 \
+              --expect-racket-version "$RACKET_VERSION" \
+              --expect-lock-digest 'unused' \
+              --root "$root" 2>/tmp/tampered.err; then
+            echo "::error::tampered manifest was ACCEPTED — contract violated"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "PASS: tampered manifest rejected:"
+          sed -n '1,3p' /tmp/tampered.err
+
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      # Negative test B — non-allowlisted path must FAIL.
+      # Simulates a smuggled artifact carrying repository or home-dir data.
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      - name: Negative - artifact with non-allowlisted path must fail
+        if: matrix.role == 'full'
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          ARTIFACT_NAME: prepared-env-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+          RACKET_VERSION: ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/prepared-env-${ARTIFACT_NAME}"
+          # Smuggle two forbidden entries: the git directory and a home-dir file.
+          mkdir -p "$root/.git" "$root/home"
+          printf '[core]\n' > "$root/.git/config"
+          printf 'token=leak\n' > "$root/home/.netrc"
+
+          lock_digest=$(racket ci/prepared-environment/manifest.rkt digest --file ci/racket-package-lock.rktd)
+          if racket ci/prepared-environment/manifest.rkt verify \
+              --manifest "$root/manifest.json" \
+              --expect-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+              --expect-git-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
+              --expect-os "$RUNNER_OS" \
+              --expect-arch x64 \
+              --expect-racket-version "$RACKET_VERSION" \
+              --expect-lock-digest "$lock_digest" \
+              --root "$root" 2>/tmp/extra-path.err; then
+            echo "::error::artifact with non-allowlisted paths was ACCEPTED — contract violated"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "PASS: non-allowlisted paths rejected:"
+          sed -n '1,3p' /tmp/extra-path.err
+
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      # Rollback parity — RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT=off must reproduce the
+      # current per-job setup path byte-for-byte in behavior.
+      # -----------------------------------------------------------------
+      - name: Rollback - RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT=off uses the current setup path
+        if: matrix.role == 'full'
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT: 'off'
+          RACKET_VERSION: ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [ "${RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT}" != "off" ]; then
+            echo "::error::rollback switch not honored"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT=off — restoring the current per-job path via ./.github/actions/setup-racket"
+
+      - name: Rollback - current per-job setup under the off switch
+        if: matrix.role == 'full' && steps.lock-gate.outputs.supported == 'true'
+        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-racket
+        with:
+          racket-version: ${{ matrix.racket-version }}
+
+      - name: Pilot summary
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          cat >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" <<EOF
+          ## Prepared-environment pilot (${{ matrix.os }} / Racket ${{ matrix.racket-version }})
+          - role: ${{ matrix.role }}
+          - lock gate: ${{ steps.lock-gate.outputs.supported }}
+          - decision authority: docs/reports/prepared-environment-pilot-v1.00.11.md
+          EOF
